headline: Competitive pressure increased, but the strongest near-term move is sharper positioning rather than discounting.
executive_summary: A competitor introduced a lower-priced entry offer.
The client's core conversion metric improved modestly versus the previous period.
The agency completed the planned landing-page message test.
The next recommendation is a value-led comparison test, not a price cut.

signals.fact: Competitor A introduced a lower-priced starter plan.
signals.impact: The perceived entry-price advantage has narrowed.

learnings: Messaging that emphasizes time-to-value performed better than broad feature messaging in the current test.
Price is becoming more visible in the category, but there is not yet evidence that the client should discount.

recommendations.why: Respond to the competitor's price move by making economic value and time-to-value explicit.

recommendations.action: Interview three recent prospects on price sensitivity
recommendations.why: Validate whether entry price is actually affecting purchase decisions before changing packaging.

decisions_needed: Confirm access to recent prospect interview candidates
